description: Who is behind a Base wallet — kind (wallet/contract, token, proxy), Basename, age, tx count, ETH + USDC balance, first funder (amount, when, its age and flags), tokens it launched, phishing/mixer/sanction/scam flags, activity label, and a trusted/normal/caution/high_risk verdict with a 0-100 trust score, red/green flags and the rule that set it. 404/free if the address was never used; 503/free if the chain read is down.
